name:
Fraksi Kebangkitan Bangsa
(Gus Dur)
summary:
The National Awakening Party (PKB) functions as the electoral wing of Nahdlatul Ulama (NU), Indonesia's largest traditionalist Islamic organization with over thirty million adherents. While Matori Abdul Djalil holds the chairmanship in Senayan, the party's spiritual and tactical direction obeys Abdurrahman Wahid—Gus Dur. Winning fifty-one seats in June 1999, PKB anchors a vast, rural voting bloc concentrated across East and Central Java, where NU's network of ulama, boarding schools (pesantren), and village shrines outlasts any secular party machine.

Theologically pluralist and fiercely opposed to enforcing Islamic law through the state, PKB rejects the sectarian rigidities championed by conservative factions. Yet Gus Dur's mercurial political artistry keeps his caucus open to alignment with whoever serves his overarching strategy. Rooted in neo-modernist Islamic discourse, his brand of pluralism harmonizes Islamic jurisprudence with Indonesian nationalism. Financial support for rural pesantren, medical diplomacy, and respect for traditionalist networks secure this bloc's cooperation, though Gus Dur holds ultimate ambition for the presidency himself.
biography:
Formed in July 1998 immediately following the collapse of the New Order, PKB gave Nahdlatul Ulama's clergy their first legal political vehicle since Suharto's forced 1973 party fusion (fusi) drove NU into PPP. Gus Dur—then recovering from a severe stroke that left him visually impaired—envisioned PKB as an inclusive, nationalist home for traditionalist Islam that contextualized Koranic and Hadith interpretation for a modern democratic society.

Initial assumptions that PKB would form an automatic coalition with Megawati Sukarnoputri's PDI Perjuangan—grounded in Gus Dur and Megawati's long-standing personal friendship—dissolved as Gus Dur began playing the major factions against one another to position himself as the master kingmaker of the transition. Fusing traditional Javanese political intuition with deep theological authority, he moves through Jakarta's corridors as the pivotal figure capable of bridging the secular-religious chasm threatening the Republic.

interactions.text: Direct state development funds toward the pesantren heartland of East Java
interactions.description: The rural pesantren networks across East Java—specifically around Jombang and the Tebuireng madrasah founded by Gus Dur's grandfather, Hasyim Asy'ari—form the organizational bedrock beneath PKB's parliamentary seats. Route a discreet infusion of state agricultural and educational funds directly into those rural districts.
interactions.alertMsg: Gus Dur sends his wry, unpredictable regards through an intermediary at Bina Graha, acknowledging the gesture with characteristic dry amusement. In Jombang and the East Java countryside, the rural clerics whose influence drives PKB's turnout register the support with satisfaction.

interactions.text: Arrange confidential international medical evacuation and specialist care for Gus Dur
interactions.description: Abdurrahman Wahid's failing vision and chronic health complications require expert neurological attention abroad. Coordinate through a secure private channel—bypassing the public health bureaucracy—to fly specialist physicians to Jakarta or arrange treatment in Europe. Secures a vital political obligation from Gus Dur's inner circle that carries forward into the Central Axis.
interactions.alertMsg: The assistance is accepted with characteristic dry wit rather than conventional deference. Those closest to Gus Dur note the gesture, recognizing that the Palace extended a humanitarian hand when politics hung in the balance.

interactions.text: Coordinate security in NU strongholds directly with GP Ansor and Banser militia units
interactions.description: Nahdlatul Ulama's youth wing (GP Ansor) maintains its own uniformed security corps (Banser) across Java, mobilizing hundreds of thousands of young men for crowd control and defense of religious sites. Rather than relying solely on ABRI detachments in traditionalist strongholds, open a direct liaison channel to Banser's command staff to maintain public order.
interactions.alertMsg: The security coordination functions without friction, allowing Banser units to quell potential sectarian flashpoints across Central and East Java without deploying territorial troops. Cilangkap generals, watching a civilian administration parley directly with religious militias, grumble behind closed doors.

interactions.text: Appoint PKB Chairman Matori Abdul Djalil to a senior cabinet portfolio
interactions.description: While Gus Dur holds spiritual command over the party, Matori Abdul Djalil manages PKB's legislative machinery in Senayan. Elevate Matori to a major cabinet post to anchor the party's institutional wing firmly to your administration ahead of October. Secures a lasting political debt from PKB's parliamentary leadership.
interactions.alertMsg: Matori Abdul Djalil accepts the portfolio with evident pleasure, cementing an institutional bridge between PKB's parliamentary caucus and Bina Graha as the MPR General Session approaches.

interactions.text: Subsidize Nahdlatul Ulama's national congress and affiliated regional madrasahs
interactions.description: The upcoming national congress of Nahdlatul Ulama and the upkeep of thousands of affiliated boarding schools across the archipelago require substantial financial backing. Authorize a direct state grant to support the proceedings.
interactions.alertMsg: NU's executive board accepts the state contribution with deep appreciation, and news of the presidential backing travels through traditionalist networks across Java within days.
